name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Berry White
description:
Sweet, smooth, and berry-forward. The Cheech & Chong Berry White D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Berry White brings a rich, fruit-forward profile: ripe blueberry and mixed berry sweetness up front, layered with a smooth, creamy finish and a subtle earthy backbone. It's a mellow, flavor-forward pick that stays easy from the first pull to the last.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Berry White flavor — ripe blueberry and mixed berry with a creamy finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Sweet flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Berry White is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
